records.rationale: Authoring, publishing, or tool-specific material outside deacon's consumer-only runtime scope (constitution II).

Catalogue entry naming a third-party product in the ecosystem list (the reference CLI). It describes what another tool is, not an obligation on a consuming implementation, and deacon has no surface on which 'a CLI exists' could be observed. Same ground as this document's other tool-catalogue records.

Documents `customizations.vscode.extensions`, a key owned by an editor. deacon carries `customizations` through verbatim (variable-substituted per bhv-readconfig-substitution-object-fields) and attributes no meaning to its contents; installing editor extensions is editor behavior deacon has no command for. Out of consumer-only scope.
